## Essay use

Direct interlocutor for zero as meta-sign and the emergence of a meta-subject within signifying systems. The record is crucial because the essay both uses and contests Rotman's constructivist/semiotic account.

**Passages needed:** “Emergence of a Meta-Subject” (chapter 2, pages 27–56 in the 1987 edition); the account of zero as meta-sign; the relation among numeral, vanishing point, and imaginary money; the work's claims about origin/absence.

**Claim boundary:** preserve the divergence. Rotman develops the semiotic production of a meta-subject; the essay treats the subject as the irreducible pole whose models and signs can be observed. Assimilating the two would require a further argument about their different ontological commitments.
